source: Creature.getCalculators(): the function lists behind the numbers
note: Per creature and stat, the functions of its Calculator in evaluation order (Calculator.addFunc keeps them sorted by order, equal orders in insertion order). class = the Func* class, owner = item:<id> (item stat functions), skill:<id>:<level> (functions of the skill itself), skill:<id>:<level>/<Effect> (functions made by a passive skill effect), or null (the standard formula functions every creature gets), cond = class of the apply condition or null. Debugging aid for the stat engine; the numbers to match are in the stats_*.json files.
